_comment: Source of truth for the in-app 'update available' sheet. Publish a byte-identical copy to https://hayyaprayer.com/version.json once a build is live on the store. Full instructions: CICD.md, 'Announcing a store update'.

notes: Add the Hijri date, or the next prayer and its time, to your Apple Watch face. Hold the face, tap Edit.
Two new widgets: a ring on your home screen that fills up as the next prayer gets closer, and the next prayer time on your lock screen.
Move any prayer time up to an hour either way to match your masjid. Your alarms follow it.
A new look for Home: the next prayer has a bigger card, and you tap a prayer to change its settings.
Duas for how you feel: pick anxious, sad, afraid, in debt and more to get duas, ayahs and short talks for it.
Read the Qur’an in the IndoPak script, as it is printed in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh.
Hayya now turns when you turn a tablet or an open foldable phone, and fits the wider screen.
Move any prayer time up to an hour either way to match your masjid. Your alarms follow it.

Duas for how you feel: pick anxious, sad, afraid, in debt and more to get duas, ayahs and short talks for it.
Read the Qur’an in the IndoPak script, as it is printed in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh.
Updates install inside Hayya: tap Update now and Google Play installs the new version without leaving the app.
